# RSA-2048 chain whose intermediate carries a legacy-hash signature, for the chain signature-hash floor tests.
# root_cert (self-signed, serial 1, sha256) -> issuer_md5_cert / issuer_sha1_cert (one issuer key and subject, serial 2,
# CA:TRUE; signed by the root with md5WithRSAEncryption / sha1WithRSAEncryption) -> leaf_cert (serial 3, SAN=localhost,
# EKU serverAuth, sha256, issued by the issuer key, so it chains through either issuer certificate).
# Validity 2020-01-01..2099-12-31. Generated with OpenSSL 4.0.1 (NB=20200101000000Z, NA=20991231000000Z; MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*'):
#   openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out X.key   (root, iss, leaf)
#   openssl req -new -x509 -key root.key -sha256 -subj "/CN=TlsLib Md5 Test Root" -set_serial 1 -not_before NB -not_after NA
#     -addext "basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE" -addext "keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign" -addext "subjectKeyIdentifier=hash" -out root.pem
#   openssl req -new -key iss.key -subj "/CN=TlsLib Md5 Test Issuer" -out iss.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in iss.csr -CA root.pem -CAkey root.key -set_serial 2 -md5|-sha1 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile iss.ext -out iss_md5|iss_sha1.pem
#     iss.ext: basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE / keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign / subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   openssl req -new -key leaf.key -subj "/CN=localhost" -out leaf.csr
#   openssl x509 -req -in leaf.csr -CA iss_md5.pem -CAkey iss.key -set_serial 3 -sha256 -not_before NB -not_after NA -extfile leaf.ext -out leaf.pem
#     leaf.ext: basicConstraints=CA:false / keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature / extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth / subjectAltName=DNS:localhost /
#               subjectKeyIdentifier=hash / authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid
#   openssl x509 -in X.pem -outform DER | xxd -p   (each field)
root_
issuer_md5_
issuer_sha1_
leaf_
